summary: Tested new features: A) Template PowerBI ZIP and B) Webhook configuration. All 17 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified for both /admin/powerbi (download button) and /admin/config (Webhooks tab).
critical_code_review_comments: router.py comment says '6 scripts M-Query' but actually generates 7 files (6 .m files + README.txt) — minor doc mismatch
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature A (Template ZIP) and Feature B (Webhook) fully working. ZIP returns 7 files with correct names. Webhook tab in /admin/config shows toggle, URL field (pre-filled https://example.com/hook), event checkboxes (project.created, project.updated), HMAC secret, example payload. Fire-and-forget confirmed (project update returns 200 within 10s despite invalid webhook URL). All legacy PowerBI endpoints still return 200 with Bearer JWT.
